import ast
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
import numpy as np
source = Path('/home/liyufeng/safeduo/artifacts/safety_native_acceptance_20261007_2307/native_full_view_runner.py').read_text()
tree = ast.parse(source)
cls = next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name == 'VisualTrace')
step = next(n for n in cls.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == 'step')
start = next(i for i, n in enumerate(step.body) if isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t, ast.Name) and t.id == 'chosen' for t in n.targets))
assert isinstance(step.body[start + 1], ast.For)
loop = ast.Module(body=step.body[start:start + 2], type_ignores=[])
code = compile(ast.fix_missing_locations(loop), '<old-selector-exact-ast>', 'exec')
labels = np.zeros(64, dtype=int)
labels[[9, 13]] = 1
scope = dict(np=np, self=SimpleNamespace(failure_labels_seen=set()), labels=labels)
scope['bad'] = np.arange(64) == 13
exec(code, scope)
first = list(scope['chosen'])
scope['bad'] = np.isin(np.arange(64), [9, 13])
exec(code, scope)
second = list(scope['chosen'])
print(dict(first=first, late_same_label_expected=[9], late_same_label_actual=second), flush=True)
assert first == [13]
assert second == [9], 'old per-stratum selector loses late env9 after env13'
